title: Code for: Discriminating mechanisms of ultrasensitivity in bacterial nitrogen signaling
description: Reproducible code, digitized published-data coordinates, parameter provenance, figure data and numerical verification for the manuscript Discriminating mechanisms of ultrasensitivity in bacterial nitrogen signaling. Includes baseline response constraints; data-matched ladder and population alternatives; finite GlnD/GlnE regulatory-state equivalences; protein-conserving cascade bounds and topology/input extensions; and conditional measurement design. No new experimental data were generated. The models use explicitly stated reaction assumptions and illustrative parameter scenarios.
